name: fs-career
description: Repo-wide tooling only. Each package installs and builds on its own.

scripts.fallow: fallow dead-code && fallow dupes --fail-on-issues && fallow health --complexity --fail-on-issues
scripts.check: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter connector --filter desktop --filter ui typecheck && pnpm --filter backend --filter frontend build && pnpm fallow
